results.name: SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer

product.title: SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer
product.description:
SHEGLAM Sunburst Glow Mixer Foundation in Fair Neutral is a lightweight, buildable liquid foundation enhancer designed to give your skin a radiant, sun-kissed glow.
Its silky formula blends seamlessly into the skin, delivering a luminous, dewy finish while evening out the complexion. You can use it alone for a natural glow, mix it with foundation for added radiance, or apply it as a liquid highlighter on high points of the face.

Perfect for creating bright, youthful, glowy makeup looks without feeling heavy.

 Key Benefits
• Adds instant glow & radiance to any makeup look
• Lightweight, smooth & blendable formula
• Can be mixed with foundation or worn alone
• Provides a dewy, fresh-skin finish
• Enhances complexion without cakiness
• Suitable for all skin types
• Fair Neutral shade works best for fair to light skin with neutral undertone

 How to Use

1. As a Glow Mixer:
Mix 1–2 drops with your liquid foundation for a luminous, radiant finish.

2. As a Liquid Highlighter:
Apply directly on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid’s bow, and brow bones.

3. As a Light Base:
Use a thin layer alone for a natural glow on no-makeup days.

4. Blend Properly:
Use fingertips, a blending sponge, or a foundation brush for a smooth finish.

product.title: Huda Beauty Life Liner Duo Pencil & Liquid Eyeliner
product.description:
A definitive LifeProof double finished eyeliner with a fluid tip on one side and pencil on the other. Enduring, waterproof, smirch evidence, and blur verification. At long last, a liner that you can trust to wait while staying very matte and very dark.

* As long as 48-hour wear*

* Double finished

* Extraordinary dark

* Smudgeproof *in view of the fluid liner


HOW TO USE 

1. Open the liquid side of the liner and wipe off any excess formula from the brush

2. Start from the outer corner of your eye begin to create your wing, working inwards towards the center of your lid

3. Complete the line starting from the inner corner of your eye, connecting the two lines at the center of the lid filling in any negative space

4. Allow to dry for approximately 60 seconds, depending on how thick your line is. The thicker your liner is, the longer it will take to dry

Pencil liner:

1. Complete your look or apply along your lash and/or waterline for extra drama

2. We gave it some playtime so you can experiment with your look before the formula sets
